Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: After reaching the Wayback Machine and submitting the site URL (step 11), WebSurfer failed to navigate the snapshot calendar to select the relevant March 22 and April 21, 2021 captures or try likely menu sub-URLs (e.g., /menu, /dinner, PDFs). Instead, it fell into repetitive, vague instructions and broad searches, exhibiting looping and ineffective use of the archival tool. This early failure to properly interact with the Wayback snapshots set the course for continued non-progress and ultimately the wrong (no-answer) outcome.
